meta.title: Tax-credit applications CHFA did not fund, mapped by their printed address
meta.outcome_rule: Each CHFA Applicant Report (and the rolling federal 4% and MIHTC lists) is read as a table; a report whose rows do not add up to the TOTALS row it prints contributes none. Contact names, emails and phones are not read. Outcomes are derived: a project counts as awarded when the same name and city is on a CHFA award report in data/policy/funding-awards/ledger.json for the same credit within two years; not_awarded only when that round's award report is published and the project is on none. CHFA prints neither 'not awarded' nor 'withdrawn'.
meta.geocoder: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder, address batch, Public_AR_Current (https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/locations/addressbatch)
meta.kept: Address matches only (exact or non-exact). An unmatched address gets no point.
meta.score_method: Market analysis engine (js/market-analysis.js) run at the geocoded address with today's data, once for each buffer the page offers, as for the funded reference properties. Our score today. The application's own homes were never built, so they are not in its area's existing supply, while a funded property's homes are.
